explication: CLI-Anything makes software controllable by agents through purpose-built command-line harnesses, with CLI-Hub for discovering and installing them and preview tooling for inspecting outputs and execution trajectories. A representative harness exposes domain commands, which call a backend to communicate with the target application or service; the sampled ChromaDB search command demonstrates collection resolution and querying. The repository tree documents many other harness domains, but their internal wiring was not sampled, so those relationships are not generalized here.
